reason: A client-side DSH Web theme plugin that provides coordinated dark and light visual styles, animated plankton effects, and runtime animation controls without changing application component logic.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供深海与浅海双模式主题、对话区浮游生物动画以及可实时调整动画参数的界面增强。
summaries.en: A DSH Web client-side theme plugin offering coordinated dark and light styles, animated plankton effects in the conversation area, and runtime animation controls.

capabilities: Injects client-side CSS to override site-wide visual tokens and component styling
Adds a canvas-based plankton animation to the conversation area
Adds a parameter button and panel for adjusting animation settings at runtime
Adapts visuals to dark/light mode and reduced-motion preferences
